data: Is the lightest cell in the confusion matrix located in the 'msa' row and 'egy' column?

The lightest cell in the confusion matrix is located at the intersection of the 'msa' row and 'egy' column. This can be verified by observing the color gradient, where the darkest cells represent the highest values and the lightest cells represent the lowest values. The cell at this position appears to be the lightest among all other cells in the matrix. Therefore, the answer is yes.
